name: round-5-fresh-weights-2026-10-11
selection: Same earlier Tier 1 folds, no Brier regression in either and no aggregate accuracy regression, lowest mean Brier
promotion: No automatic promotion; retain the current live model unless a separate future test confirms improvement

candidates.name: baseline
candidates.hypothesis: Control with frozen model weights and causal online ratings

candidates.name: more_recent_weights_70
candidates.hypothesis: Use 70% for fitting and 10% for calibration instead of 60% and 20%, preserving the last 20% test

candidates.name: more_recent_weights_75
candidates.hypothesis: Use 75% for fitting and 5% for calibration so hero weights reflect more recent maps

candidates.name: rolling_training_90_days
candidates.hypothesis: Discard older training examples, while retaining all causal history for player and team ratings

candidates.name: monthly_refit_80
candidates.hypothesis: Refresh weights at each following month boundary using only results available then, with an 80/20 past-data training/calibration split

candidates.name: monthly_refit_90
candidates.hypothesis: Monthly updates using a larger and fresher training portion and a smaller calibration portion

excluded_previous_ideas: No tuning dates, windows or blend weights using four-month outcomes
guardrails: At monthly updates, labels must be available before month start including a 60-second completion buffer
Keep earlier development-test maps separate for static models
Walk-forward models may learn only already completed earlier test maps, as a real deployment would
